summary.text: Anthony H. Palumbo is a Republican member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 1 since January 2021 and is running for re-election on the Republican and Conservative lines.
He previously served in the New York State Assembly and as a Suffolk County assistant district attorney.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Palumbo's career experience includes work as an assistant district attorney with Suffolk County, according to Ballotpedia.
He represented Assembly District 2 from 2014 to 2021 before succeeding Kenneth LaValle in the State Senate.

For the 2025 to 2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as ranking member of the Senate Judiciary and Codes committees and a member of the Mental Health and Environmental Conservation committees, among others.
